newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria, Mongolia to revive gold mining venture.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria, Mongolia to revive gold mining venture.

text.p: Bulgaria's cabinet on Monday approved the revival of a Bulgarian-Mongolian gold mining joint venture in Mongolia, a government spokeswoman said.
The new venture, named Mongolbulgargeo, replaces the Mongolbulgarmetal joint venture established in 1979 on the basis of an agreement between the two former communist governments.

Mongolbulgarmetal ceased operations in 1990 after the Mongolian side opted out of the contract, but the two countries resumed talks in 1994 and agreed to set up Mongolbulgargeo with each of them holding 50 percent. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-91188
